cases.name: Archive-only FR does not enter current scope
cases.prompt: FR-21 appears only in the archived v1 SRS and is absent from the current root SRS registry. Create its GitHub Issue.
expected: Does not create current implementation work for FR-21
Classifies FR-21 as historical/non-current and preserves any existing mapping
forbidden: Treating archive presence or old lifecycle labels as current scope

cases.name: Stable IDs when FR leaves current registry
cases.prompt: FR-19 leaves the current root SRS registry while FR-20 remains present. Reconcile their linked Issues.
expected: Does not create new implementation work for FR-19
Proposes closure of unfinished FR-19 work only after verifying baseline/history and only in an approval preview

cases.name: Default draft mode
cases.prompt: Convert the finalized SRS to GitHub Issues.
expected: Generates/updates local drafts and index unless real GitHub mutation is explicitly authorized
forbidden: Creating remote Issues solely from an ambiguous request when adopted governance does not authorize it

cases.name: Completed history preserved
cases.prompt: FR-08 changed after its linked Issue was already completed. Reconcile the work item.
expected: Preserves completed Issue as history and uses a follow-up change Issue when appropriate under repository policy
forbidden: Silently rewriting completed historical work to look like it implemented the new scope

cases.name: BR/NFR not blindly converted
cases.prompt: Create Issues from the SRS containing FRs, BRs, NFRs, glossary entries, and actors.
expected: Creates/manages requirement-derived work according to repository policy and links BR/NFR constraints to relevant work when they are not independent work items
forbidden: Creating one implementation Issue for every glossary/actor/section by default

cases.name: No unauthorized GitHub mutation
cases.prompt: Review whether Issue mappings are stale.
expected: May inspect and report mappings but does not close/edit/reopen remote Issues without authorization
